results.question: Total stock per product vendor
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p."productVendor",
  SUM(p."quantityInStock") AS "totalStock"
FROM 
  "products" p
  LEFT JOIN "employees" e ON p."productVendor"::text = e."employeeNumber"::text
WHERE 
  p."productVendor" != ''
GROUP BY 
  p."productVendor";
